newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - April 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - April 23.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Liu Tai-ying, head of Nationalist Party's Business Management Committee, loses libel suit against Hong Kong-based Yazhou Zhoukan magazine.
Taiwan to lift ban on video game parlours by end of month.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Liu Tai-ying says will not rule out appeal in libel suit.
Robber dies after one intended victim bit his penis and another slashed him.
LIBERTY TIMES - United States considers Taiwan partner in protection of wild animals.
Number of city and county council seats to increase by 40 to 45.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Shinkong Synthetic Fibres chairman Wu Tong-chin replaced by brother Wu Tong-liang.
Export orders in March exceed US$10 billion.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Taiwan exports turn toward Europe.
